report.title: Todo command doesn't work in some desktop browsers
report.body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

v0.25.3

### Bug Description

When i use `/todo` command it doesn't work in most **desktop** browsers.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. In Google Сhrome browser open a note in edit mode
2. Press `/` in the very beginning of an empty line
3. Press enter while `/todo` is highlighted

### Expected

`- [ ] ` to appear

### Actual

The line remains empty

### Additional Context

**Client envs**:
- Desktop Google Chrome browser
- Desktop Firefox browser
- Desktop Brave browser

**Notes**:
1. The feature works when the line is not empty.
2. The feature works as expected in Android Chrome browser

plan.reported_actual: The line remains empty after pressing Enter on the highlighted /todo command
missing: assumed: the report says 'open a note in edit mode'; since the instance has no data, the new-memo editor on the home page is used instead of editing an existing memo
assumed: the todo option is the highlighted item in the slash menu when it first opens; if not, it may need to be navigated to or typed as 'todo'
Does the bug also occur in the new-memo editor, or only when editing an existing memo?
Is the empty line the only line in the editor, or does it follow other content?
plan.summary: Selecting /todo on an empty line in the editor on desktop inserts nothing instead of '- [ ] '
